The observed frequency of a sound wave depends on
both the motion of the observer and the motion of the
source of the sound wave. A researcher performed an
experiment to study the frequency of sound waves recorded
launcher at one end and a foam pit at the other. She placed
a loudspeaker emitting a sound wave with a frequency of
hertz (Hz) above the launcher and an audio-recording
device in a cart positioned by the launcher. See Figure 1.

analysis to determine the distance and speed of the cart as
it moved along the track. Figure
